verdict.rationale: Sumsub lets ops configure verification levels (step sequences) and build them from a plain-language description with the Summy AI level builder. Client lists can drive verification flows. Wording, email templates and branding can be changed and previewed through configuration rather than code. However, nothing in the pack shows conditional step branching, risk-based routing between levels, or country-specific requirement rules. Missing for 10: documented conditional/branching steps, risk-based routing, country-specific requirement configuration, explicit no-deploy change workflow, independent corroboration.
